query: We're planning to deploy the new payment processing service to production next Tuesday. Can you create a release checklist covering all the pre-deployment validation we need?
What's our rollback plan if the v2.4 API migration causes issues in production? I need documented steps the on-call team can follow.
Are we ready to ship the user authentication overhaul? I want a go/no-go assessment based on our current test coverage and open bugs.
Prepare a post-release monitoring plan for the new search indexing service. What metrics should we watch for the first 48 hours after launch?
We need a deployment checklist for the database migration from PostgreSQL 14 to 16. Include rollback triggers and verification steps.
Can you help me assess launch readiness for our mobile app v3.0? We need sign-off from engineering, QA, and product before releasing to the app store.
I need to prepare a go/no-go decision document for the microservices cutover. What criteria should we evaluate and what are the release blockers?
Help me build a canary deployment plan for rolling out the new recommendation engine. I need rollback criteria and phased rollout percentages.
We shipped the billing update yesterday and error rates are climbing. What should our post-release review cover and how do we decide whether to roll back?
Create a pre-release validation checklist for our feature flag rollout of the new dashboard. Include security sign-off, stress test verification, and observability checks.
Write a comprehensive test plan for the new checkout flow including unit tests, integration tests, and end-to-end test scenarios.
Review the architecture of our event-driven notification system and suggest improvements for scalability and fault tolerance.
Help me set up a GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline that runs linting, tests, and builds a Docker image on every pull request.
I need to create a Grafana monitoring dashboard for our Kubernetes cluster that shows CPU, memory, and pod health metrics.
Write an incident response runbook for handling a database outage, including escalation procedures and communication templates.
Help me gather and document the functional and non-functional requirements for the new inventory management module.
Can you do a code review of my pull request? I want feedback on the error handling patterns and whether the API contracts are well-defined.
Set up Terraform infrastructure for a new staging environment with load balancing, auto-scaling, and database provisioning.
I need to write API documentation for our REST endpoints including request/response schemas, authentication, and rate limiting details.
Help me design a load testing strategy using k6 to simulate 10,000 concurrent users hitting our checkout API.
